description: Documentation for the CDPSession class, which facilitates communication with the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It details how to create sessions, send protocol commands, handle events, and the methods available across multiple programming language implementations, primarily focusing on usage examples and method signatures.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: Represents a session for communicating with Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling sending commands and subscribing to events.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the CDPSession from the target, stops event emission, and makes it unusable for further communication.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command to the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Supports multiple language-specific overloads with varying return types.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The protocol method name to call.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional parameters for the protocol command.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns an event emitter for a specified DevTools Protocol event name.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific DevTools Protocol event.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unregisters an event handler for a specific DevTools Protocol event.
